issue_context.title: Using shard index to scatter integer hot index
issue_context.body:
[](url)## Enhancement
Hot index reduces the write scalability of the TiDB cluster when the written data is monotonically increasing. Using an expression index to scatter the hot index, the new expression index is called a shard index. The expression prefix of shard index must be tidb_shard() that is a new TiDB built-in function.

In order to simplify the work, Only scatter integer unique index. e.g. there is a index "unique key(id)" and it is a hot index. Using the new index "unique key(tidb_shard(id), id)" to replace it.

There are scalability of hot index and shard index.
scalability of hot index
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/87681388/147439747-38061f64-32be-4adf-9ab9-4093ef88da96.png)

scalability of shard index
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/87681388/147439914-c0763c17-741e-424e-969f-acd8d4776bd1.png)

We add the prefix just for point get.
For index `shard(a), a, b`, The `a > 1` cannot be used but `a = 1 and b > 2` can.
we support shard index just for unique secondary index and point get plan. For index `(shard(a), a, b)`, the condition  `a = 1 and b > 2` can't make a point get plan.
The leaf of the DNF can still be a CNF(And clause), so we may need to call `addExprPrefix4CNFCond`.
